title: Show HN: Chiptune Radio
summary: A web-based chiptune (8-bit) music generator that broadcasts algorithmically generated retro game-style music in real-time. Built as a creative hobby project to produce endless unique nostalgic chiptune tracks.
problem_solved: Generates infinite, royalty-free 8-bit style music on demand, eliminating the need for pre-made chiptune tracks or licensing concerns.
why_valuable: Provides game developers and content creators with a free, endless source of authentic retro game music without copyright or royalty issues.
